other_conditions: Must have passed +2 examination with at least 60% aggregate marks conducted by CHSE, Odisha
For UG level: must be admitted to +3 Arts with Odia as Honours subject in a Degree/Autonomous College or State University (Odisha or other states)
For PG level: must be admitted to M.A. (Odia) in a State University/Degree/Autonomous College in Odisha after securing at least 60% marks in Odia Honours subject
Students pursuing distance learning or correspondence courses are not eligible
Students receiving other scholarships are still eligible
benefits_summary: One‑time scholarship of ₹20,000 per student, with 1,500 awards annually (1,200 for UG and 300 for PG).
